summary: This Phase 4 clinical trial is looking at how a combination of cholesterol-lowering medications affects gut microbiota, which are the helpful bacteria living in your digestive tract. The study is currently Recruiting 110 participants who have atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease with dyslipidemia, a condition involving narrowed arteries and unhealthy fat levels in the blood. Yonsei University is sponsoring the research to see how these treatments change the balance of bacteria in the gut over a period of 12 weeks. NCT06784557 is the identifier for this study.
